[1;90mHEXAGRAM:
[90m[Traditional Chinese]

  [0m(Scripture)
  [1;97m乾：元亨，利貞。

  [0m(Exegesis)
  [1;97m天行健，君子以自強不息。

[90m[Simplified Chinese]

  [0m(Scripture)
  [1;97m乾：元亨，利贞。

  [0m(Exegesis)
  [1;97m天行健，君子以自强不息。

[90m[English, Wilhelm-Baynes]

  [0m(Scripture)
  [1;97mTHE CREATIVE works sublime success,
  Furthering through perseverance.

  [0m(Exegesis)
  [1;97mThe movement of heaven is full of power.
  Thus the superior man makes himself strong and untiring.

[90m[English, James Legge]

  [0m(Scripture)
  [1;97mKhien (represents) what is great and originating, penetrating, advantageous, correct and firm.

  [0m(Exegesis)
  [1;97mI. Heaven, in its motion, (gives the idea of) strength. The superior man, in accordance with this, nerves himself to ceaseless activity.
